q1.a: CareerAI is an AI-powered career guidance platform that helps you discover the best career based on your interests, personality, skills, goals, and salary potential.

q2.a: Yes. You can take the AI career test and explore your top career matches completely free. Premium plans unlock advanced roadmaps and coaching.

q3.a: Our models combine assessments with labor market data from 50+ countries, continuously improving accuracy with every user interaction.

q4.a: CareerAI is currently available in English and Uzbek, with more languages coming soon.

q5.q: Can I use CareerAI as a working professional?
q5.a: Absolutely. CareerAI supports students, graduates, and professionals considering a career change at any stage.

q6.a: Your data is encrypted and never sold. You can request deletion at any time from your dashboard.
